name: Views Reference Extras
description: Overrides Views Reference Field's AJAX-settings compression with a reload strategy: instead of packing all field settings into the AJAX query string, it stores a small pointer and re-reads the settings from the source entity, avoiding 414 (URI Too Long) errors on heavily-configured embeds.
project_description:
This module is for more contributed features extending Views Reference Field allowing that module to be focused on the core functionality and be kept simple.

Features
For now this module has only one feature:

Handling complex Views Reference field configurations. Views Reference Field configurations that have many options - like control of which options are shown in a long list of terms - can result in 414 errors. Install this module to extend the compression provided in [#3396530] to reload the settings from the entity rather than passing all settings in the query string.

Post-Installation
No change is needed. The module automatically enables the above feature by overriding the viewsreference.compression service. If multiple features are eventually added, an interface for opting in to features will be set up and an upgrade hook to maintain the status quo will be in place (ie, this first feature will remain enabled on new sites).
